title: Chat Control v2
description: Chat Control V2 lets operators instantly enable or disable server chat with simple commands, while commands continue to work normally for everyone.
body: **Chat Control is a lightweight server-side mod that gives moderators full control over text chat. Using `/chat disable` and `/chat enable`, staff can instantly toggle server chat on or off at any time. All commands continue to function normally, making Chat Control perfect for voice-focused SMPs, proximity chat servers, and communities looking to encourage more natural player interaction without removing essential command functionality.**
